blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: The scarcity of non-English language data in specialized domains significantly limits the development of effective Natural Language Processing (NLP) tools. We present TransBERT, a novel framework for pre-training language models using exclusively synthetically translated text, and introduce TransCorpus, a scalable translation toolkit. Focusing on the life sciences domain in French, our approach demonstrates that state-of-the-art performance on various downstream tasks can be achieved solely by leveraging synthetically translated data. We release the TransCorpus toolkit, the TransCorpus-bio-fr corpus (36.4GB of French life sciences text), TransBERT-bio-fr, its associated pre-trained language model and reproducible code for both pre-training and fine-tuning. Our results highlight the viability of synthetic translation in a high-resource translation direction for building high-quality NLP resources in low-resource language/domain pairs.
blocks.zh: 专业领域非英语数据稀缺,极大地限制了有效的自然语言处理(NLP)工具的发展. 我们介绍TransBERT,这是专门使用合成文本进行预训的语言模型的新框架,并介绍TransCorpus,一个可扩展的翻译工具包。 以法语生命科学领域为重点,我们的方法表明,只有通过利用人工翻译的数据,才能在各种下游任务上取得最新业绩。 我们发布了TransCorpus工具包,TransCorpus-bio-fromic(法国生命科学文本的36.4GB),TransBERT-bio-fr,其相关的预训语言模型以及用于预训和微调的可复制代码. 我们的成果突出了在高资源翻译方向上合成翻译的可行性,以低资源语言/领域对齐建设高质量的NLP资源.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: PLM have revolutionized the field of NLP ( NLP ) by leveraging large-scale datasets and powerful neural network architectures to learn rich linguistic representations. These models, such as BERT Devlin et al. (2019) , GPT Radford et al. (2018) , and T5 Raffel et al. (2019) , are pre-trained on vast amounts of text data in an unsupervised manner, enabling them to capture intricate patterns and nuances of human language. PLM can be fine-tuned for specific tasks, such as text classification, NER ( NER ), and QA ( QA ), by training them on smaller labeled datasets. This transfer learning approach has significantly improved the performance of NLP models across various languages and domains.
blocks.zh: PLM通过利用大型数据集和强大的神经网络架构来学习丰富的语言表达力,使NLP(NLP)领域发生了革命性的变化. 这些模型,如BERT Devlin等人(2019年),GPT Radford等人(2018年),以及T5 Raffel等人(2019年),都以不受监督的方式对大量文本数据进行了预先培训,使它们能够捕捉人类语言的复杂规律和细微差别. PLM可以通过对文本分类,NER(NER),QA(QA)等特定任务进行微调,在较小的标签数据集上对其进行培训. 这种转学学习方法大大改善了NLP模型在不同语言和领域的性能.

blocks.en: Unfortunately, the success of PLM has not been equally distributed across all languages. While high-resource languages like English, Chinese, and French have seen significant advancements in NLP applications, many low-resource languages still lack the necessary data and resources to develop effective models. This disparity is particularly evident in specialized domains such as life sciences, where the availability of high-quality datasets is crucial for training accurate models. For example, Hindi, which is spoken by over 600M people, has no available PLM for the life sciences domain. Although BioBERT Lee et al. (2019) , the first pre-trained language model for the life sciences, was released in 2019, significant efforts to gather sufficient DS ( DS ) data for training life sciences models in other high-resource languages have begun to emerge in recent years. Since 2023, life sciences models have emerged for German Bressem et al. (2024) , Italian Buonocore et al. (2023) , and French Labrak et al. (2023) ; Touchent et al. (2023) . Life sciences is only an example of a domain where the lack of data is a significant barrier to the development of NLP tools. Other domains, such as legal, finance, and patent, also face similar challenges.
blocks.zh: 遗憾的是,PLM的成功并没有在所有语言中平等分布. 虽然英语,汉语,法语等高资源语言在NLP应用上取得了显著进步,但许多低资源语言仍然缺乏开发有效模型的必要数据和资源. 这种差异在生命科学等专门领域尤其明显,因为提供高质量的数据集对培训准确模型至关重要。 例如,600多万人讲的印地语没有生命科学领域的PLM。 虽然BioBERT Lee et al. (2019)是生命科学的首个预训语言模型,于2019年发布,但近年来已开始作出重大努力,收集足够的DS(DS)数据,以其他高资源语言培训生命科学模型. 自2023年起,生命科学模型出现于德国Bressem等人(2024年),意大利Buonocore等人(2023年),法国Labrak等人(2023年),Touchent等人(2023年). 生命科学只是一个领域的例子,因为缺乏数据是开发NLP工具的重大障碍. 法律、金融和专利等其他领域也面临类似的挑战。

blocks.en: In this paper, we introduce TransCorpus, an open-source toolkit leveraging the fairseq translation framework Ott et al. (2019) to generate extensive synthetic DS corpora in up to 100 languages, featuring a production-level API/CLI setup with multi-GPU and multi-processing capabilities, and reliable checkpoint recovery for scalable corpus management. In the context of a high-resource translation direction, we demonstrate that a LM ( LM ) trained on TransCorpus output can achieve state-of-the-art performance on various downstream tasks by leveraging DrBenchmark, a French life sciences benchmark Labrak et al. (2024b) .
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们引入了TransCorpus,一个利用fairseq翻译框架Ott et al. (2019)的开源工具包,以100种语言生成广泛的合成DS corpora,其特色是生产层面的API/CLI设置,具有多GPU和多处理能力,以及可伸缩体管理的可靠检查站恢复. 在高资源翻译方向方面,我们表明,通过利用法国生命科学基准Labrak等人(2024年b)Benchmark博士,经过TransCorpus产出培训的LM(LM)可以实现各种下游任务的先进业绩。

blocks.en: Our contributions are threefold with (1) the release of an open-source toolkit 1 1 1 https://github.com/jknafou/TransCorpus for scalable multilingual corpus translation, (2) a French life sciences corpus 2 2 2 https://huggingface.co/datasets/jknafou/TransCorpus-bio-fr synthetically translated of 36.4GB along with a tokenizer, and a PLM 3 3 3 https://huggingface.co/jknafou/TransBERT-bio-fr released on Hugging Face, and (3) reproducible code for the pre-training and fine-tuning of the French life sciences PLM made publicly available on GitHub 4 4 4 https://github.com/jknafou/TransBERT . For future research, we are in the process of adding new languages and publishing them in the Hugging Face datasets repository. To see the current state of the added languages, check out the following link: https://huggingface.co/jknafou/datasets?search=transcorpus .
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献有三个方面:(1) 发布一个开源工具包 1 1 https://github.com/jknafou/TransCorpus 用于可扩展的多语种翻译, (2) 法国生命科学教程 2 2 2 https://huggingface.co/datasets/jknafou/TransCorpus-bio-fr 合成了36.4GB和一个标注剂,以及一个PLM 3 3 3 https://huggingface.co/jknafou/TransBERT-bio-fr 在Hugging Face上发布,以及(3) 法国生命科学PLM预培训和微调的可复制代码 在GitHub 4 4 4 4 https://github.com/jknafou/TransBERT上公开发布 。 。 。 对于未来的研究,我们正在增加新语言,并在Hugging Face数据集库中发布. 要查看新增语言的现状,请查看以下链接:https://huggingface.co/jknafou/datasets?search=transcorpus.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: The paradigm of training LM on massive datasets is relatively recent, gaining prominence after the introduction of BERT Devlin et al. (2018) , and as a result, there is still limited research leveraging translation for training such models, especially in low-resource settings.
blocks.zh: 关于大规模数据集的LM培训模式相对较新,在BERT Devlin等人(2018年)推出后越来越突出,因此,利用翻译来培训这类模型的研究仍然有限,特别是在资源少的情况下。

blocks.en: In Isbister et al. (2021) , sentiment analysis in four low-resource Scandinavian languages is explored using three strategies: fine-tuning a native monolingual PLM , translating the data into English and fine-tuning an English PLM , and fine-tuning a multilingual PLM on the native data. Results generally favor the multilingual approach, though fine-tuning an English model on translated data often outperforms using a monolingual low-resource PLM .
blocks.zh: 在Isbister等人(2021年)中,使用三种策略探索四种低资源斯堪的纳维亚语言的情绪分析:精细调整本地单一语言的PLM,将数据翻译成英语并精细调整英语的PLM,以及精细调整本地数据上的多语言PLM. 成果一般倾向于多语种方法,不过在翻译数据上微调英文模型,往往比使用单一语言的低资源PLM要好。

blocks.en: For Luxembourgish, Lothritz et al. (2022) tackle data scarcity by partially translating unambiguous words from a related high-resource language, evaluating several models including a Luxembourgish-only BERT, a Luxembourgish-German BERT, and LuxemBERT, which is trained on mixed corpora. LuxemBERT shows improved performance over mBERT, though not to a statistically significant extent.
blocks.zh: 对于卢森堡语,Lothritz等人(2022年)通过从相关高资源语言中部分翻译清晰的词句来解决数据稀缺问题,评价了若干模式,包括仅使用卢森堡语的BERT、卢森堡语-德国语的BERT以及接受混合体培训的LuxemBERT。 LuxemBERT显示比mBERT的性能有所改进,尽管在统计学上并不显著.

blocks.en: In the Basque context, following the introduction of ElhBERTeu Urbizu et al. (2022) , Urbizu et al. (2023) use synthetic translated data from Spanish to enlarge the Basque corpus, finding that while a PLM trained solely on synthetic data is competitive, it does not outperform one trained only on native data; however, supplementing native data with synthetic translations does enhance performance.
blocks.zh: 在巴斯克语中,在引入ElhBERTEU Urbizu等人(2022年)之后,Urbizu等人(2023年)使用西班牙语的合成翻译数据来扩充巴斯克语体,发现仅接受合成数据培训的PLM虽然具有竞争力,但并不比仅接受本土数据培训的PLM好;然而,用合成翻译补充本土数据确实提高了性能.

blocks.en: Phan et al. (2023) improve the English-to-Vietnamese MT ( MT ) model Mtet by injecting synthetic biomedical parallel text via self-training He et al. (2019) , resulting in a system that outperforms strong baselines and enables the creation of ViPubmed and ViMedNLI datasets. Continued pre-training and fine-tuning on these resources lead to ViPubMedT5, which achieves state-of-the-art results in several biomedical NLP tasks, further demonstrating the potential of synthetic translation data for advancing low-resource language modeling.
blocks.zh: Phan等人(2023年)改进了英文对越南的MT(MT)模式. 通过自我训练注入合成生物医学平行文本的Mtet He et al. (2019年),形成了一个超过强基线的系统,并能够创建ViPubmed和ViMedNLI数据集. 继续就这些资源进行预训和微调,导致ViPubMedT5,在多项生物医学NLP任务中实现了最先进的成果,进一步展示了合成翻译数据推进低资源语言模型化的潜力.

blocks.en: Finally, Ishigaki et al. (2023) pre-train a Japanese BERT model on 2.5M abstracts from Web of Science which were translated into Japanese via Amazon Translate, alongside 1.2M native Japanese abstracts from Wikipedia. Although no comparisons are made with existing PLM , experiments involving entity and relation extraction tasks indicate that models that use translated data exhibit superior performance over those trained on native data.
blocks.zh: 最后,Ishigaki等人(2023年)在科学网2.5M摘要上预训了日本BERT模型,该模型通过Amazon Translate翻译成日文,与维基百科的1.2M日本本土摘要并列. 尽管没有与现有的PLM进行比较,但涉及实体和关系提取任务的实验表明,使用翻译数据的模型表现出优于那些受过本土数据培训的模型。

blocks.en: 3 TransCorpus: A Scalable Translation Framework
blocks.zh: 3 转录: 可扩展翻译框架

blocks.en: In this section, we present TransCorpus, a framework designed to facilitate the translation of large-scale corpora into multiple languages. First, the selection of the MT toolkit along with its model will be presented, then the model size and context length will be discussed, and finally, the proposed translation workflow will be illustrated.
blocks.zh: 在这一节中,我们介绍TransCorpus,这个框架旨在便利将大规模corpora翻译成多种语言. 首先,将介绍MT工具包的选择及其模型,然后讨论模型大小和上下文长度,最后,将说明拟议的翻译工作流程。

blocks.en: 3.1 Machine Translation Framework & Model Selection
blocks.zh: 3.1 机器翻译框架和模型选择

blocks.en: To achieve our goal of translating large volumes of text between any two languages, we selected M2M-100 Fan et al. (2020) in conjunction with fairseq as a versatile tool for implementation. Fairseq offers broad support for multilingual tasks and facilitates rapid deployment with multi-GPU processing capabilities. Facebook AI’s M2M-100 enables direct translation between languages without using English as an intermediary, making it perfect for converting text from any one of 100 languages to another. Moreover, fairseq’s modular framework allows for easy model swapping and the integration of new or specialized translation models. This flexibility customizes the translation process to meet specific needs, such as domain adaptation or the incorporation of additional languages.
blocks.zh: 为了实现在任何两种语言之间翻译大量文本的目标,我们选择了M2M-100 Fan等人(2020年)与fairseq一起作为多功能的执行工具。 Fairseq为多语种任务提供广泛支持,并促进具有多GPU处理能力的快速部署. Facebook AI的M2M-100在不使用英语作为中介的情况下,实现了语言之间的直接翻译,使文本从100种语言中的任何一种翻译到另一种语言是完美的。 此外,Fairseq的模块框架允许方便的模型交换和新的或专门的翻译模型的整合。 这种灵活性使翻译过程自定义以满足具体需要,例如域调整或纳入其他语言。

blocks.en: The M2M-100 model is available in three sizes: 418M, 1.2B, and 12B parameters. The smallest model is faster and uses less memory, while the largest requires multiple GPU for deployment. Because translation quality improvements come at a quadratic increase in computational cost, we did not consider the 12B model for our experiments. However, since the 418M and 1.2B models differ substantially in translation quality but not as much in computational cost, the next section will compare these two models, focusing primarily on computation time.
blocks.zh: M2M-100型机车有三种尺寸:418M,1.2B,12B参数. 最小的模型速度更快,使用内存较少,而最大需要多个GPU才能部署. 由于翻译质量的提高是计算成本的四倍增长,我们没有考虑我们的实验的12B模型. 然而,由于418M和1.2B模型在翻译质量上差别很大,但在计算成本上却不尽相同,下一节将比较这两个模型,主要侧重于计算时间.

blocks.en: 3.2 Model Size & Context Length
blocks.zh: 3.2 模型大小和上下文长度

blocks.en: The context length relationship with model complexity is quadratic due to the way attention mechanisms operate in transformers. As context length increases, the number of interactions that the model must account for grows quadratically because every token attends to every other token in the sequence. This means that computational resources, such as time and memory, increase significantly with longer sequences. Overlooking this relationship can lead to inefficient computation times and resource usage, particularly with large datasets or models, resulting in slower processing speeds and potentially prohibitive resource demands. Moreover, MT models such as M2M-100 typically trained on sentence pairs might exhibit unexpected behavior if used otherwise. Conversely, having no context would reduce translation to a word-by-word level, resulting in nonsensical outcomes. The following analysis explores document-based and sentence-based translation methods while considering both models sizes on a sample of 1000 life sciences abstracts.
blocks.zh: 由于注意机制在变压器中的运作方式,与模型复杂性的上下文长度关系是四极性的. 随着上下文长度的增大,模型必须计入的相互作用数量会四倍增长,因为每个符号都关注序列中的其他每个符号. 这意味着时间和内存等计算资源随着较长的序列而显著增加. 忽视这种关系可能导致计算时间和资源使用效率低下,特别是大型数据集或模型,导致处理速度放慢,资源需求可能令人望而却步。 此外,M2M-100等MT模型通常经过对句的培训,如果使用其他方式,可能会表现出意想不到的行为。 相反,没有上下文会把翻译减少到逐字逐句的水平,导致不敏感的结果。 以下分析探讨基于文档和句子的翻译方法,同时在1000个生命科学摘要样本中考虑两种模型大小.

blocks.en: Figure 1: Translation Method Analysis on a 1000-Abstracts Sample - (a) Box plot comparing the number of tokens per sentence and abstract, with a red line at 512 tokens representing the maximum token limit that M2M-100 can handle. (b) The average time to translate each abstract using the 418M and 1.2B model versions, comparing sentence-based and document-based translation. (c) Distribution of word count per abstract for both model sizes, displayed with the original English abstract at the bottom when translating by abstract (middle) and by sentence (top). All distributions are normalized to the same scale, so their areas add up to 1.
blocks.zh: 图1: 1000-Abstracts sample上的翻译方法分析 - (a) 对比每句和抽象的令牌数的框图,以512个令牌的红线表示M2M-100可以处理的最大令牌限制. (b) 使用418M和1.2B模型版本翻译每个摘要的平均时间,比较基于句法和基于文件的翻译。 (c) 以抽象(中)和句子(上)进行翻译时,在底部用英文原摘要显示的两种模型大小的每个抽象字数分布。 所有分布都正常化到相同比例,因此它们的面积加起来为1.

blocks.en: Figure 1 a clearly demonstrates that when translations are performed by sentence, the distribution tends to favor parallelization because larger differences in sequence length require more padding, leading to wasted computation. Figure 1 b shows that sentence-based translation consistently results in faster processing for any given model size, with the speed advantage becoming more pronounced as the model size increases. It is important to note that the sentence-based approach will tend to scale linearly with the amount of data to be translated, while the document-based approach will highly depend on the document length distribution of a given domain. Finally, the sentence-based approach seems to mimic the original distribution of words per translated document, while the disparity observed in Figure 1 c for the document-based approach was qualitatively reviewed and appears to be partially attributed to a’repetition’ problem. Appendix A.3 shows an observed example. As already mentioned, M2M-100 was trained on sentences pairs, which might explain this behavior.
blocks.zh: 图1清楚地表明,如果翻译是通过句子进行的,则分布往往倾向于平行化,因为序列长度的较大差异需要更多的粘贴,导致计算浪费。 图1b显示,基于句法的翻译始终能更快地处理任何给定的模型大小,随着模型大小的增加,速度优势变得更加明显. 需要注意的是,基于句子的方法往往会随着要翻译的数据量而线性地缩放,而基于文档的方法则会高度依赖于某个域的文档长度分布. 最后,以句法为基础的办法似乎模仿了每份翻译文件最初的字数分布,而图1c对以文件为基础的办法所观察到的差距作了定性审查,似乎部分归因于重复的问题。 附录A.3列举了一个观察到的例子。 如前所述,M2M-100接受了对句的训练,这可能会解释这种行为.

blocks.en: While maintaining translation consistency, the sentence-based strategy is adaptable and scalable to various types of documents. Regarding the size of the model, the difference in the translation time in sentence length is negligible compared to the gains reported in quality. This observation led to the decision to adopt the 1.2B model along with a sentence-based translation approach.
blocks.zh: 在保持翻译一致性的同时,基于句子的战略对各类文件具有适应性和可扩展性. 关于模型的大小,与所报告的质量收益相比,翻译时间在句子长度上的差别微不足道。 这一意见导致决定采用1.2B模式以及基于句法的翻译方法。

blocks.en: 3.3 Framework Translation Workflow
blocks.zh: 3.3 框架翻译工作流程

blocks.en: Figure 2 depicts TransCorpus toolkit applied to an English life sciences corpus consisting of 22M abstracts. First, the corpus is divided and distributed among different machines to parallelize the translation process. Each abstract is then divided into sentences with fairseq handling tokenization as shown in Appendix A.4 . By grouping sentences of the same length, bucketing is employed to minimize padding, thereby avoiding the computational inefficiency that results from juxtaposing long and short sentences. Although it may seem counterintuitive, there is a considerable increase in speed when translating sentences of the same length simultaneously. Once the sentences are translated, they are matched with their respective abstracts and sentence numbers, and the entire corpus is reconciled by concatenating each output of each subprocess. Appendix A.5 shows an abstract translation example. To avoid too short context issues, sentences that contain fewer than 10 characters are concatenated to the following or preceding sentence.
blocks.zh: 图2 TransCorpus工具包适用于由22M摘要组成的英国生命科学教程。 首先,教程在不同的机器中进行划分和分配,以平行翻译过程. 然后,将每个摘要分为句子,并如附录A.4所示,用fairseq处理符号化。 通过对相同长度的句子进行分组,使用桶装来尽量减少粘贴,从而避免了同时使用长句和短句导致的计算效率低下. 虽然它可能看起来是反直觉的,但在同时翻译相同长度的句子时,速度有相当大的提高. 句子一经翻译,就与各自的摘要和句号相匹配,通过调和每个子进程的每个输出来调和整个内容. 附录A.5显示了一个抽象的翻译实例. 为了避免上下文问题太短,包含少于10个字符的句子被拼凑为以下或前一句.

blocks.en: Figure 2: TransCorpus Translation Workflow - Illustration of the deployment of TransCorpus on a machine with 32 GPU .
blocks.zh: 图2: TransCorpus 翻译工作流程 - TransCorpus在一台带有32 GPU的机器上的部署图示.

blocks.en: The TransCorpus toolkit includes a CLI ( CLI ) that features four primary commands: (1) transcorpus download-corpus [domain] allows users to fetch a corpus from specified domains, (2) transcorpus preprocess [domain] [target-language] [num-splits] allows users to optionally preprocess the corpus before translating, and (3) transcorpus translate [domain] [target-language] [num-splits] handles both preprocessing (if not previously completed) and translating the corpus. Users can perform preprocessing and translation concurrently across numerous GPU and processes. A checkpoint recovery feature enables users to resume preprocessing or translation from where it last stopped, which is especially beneficial for academics facing GPU usage time limits. Lastly, (4) transcorpus preview [domain] [language1] [language2] provides a side-by-side document preview of the corpus in two languages. Currently, only the life sciences corpus is ready for download, but by updating the domains.json file on GitHub with a new corpus URL, additional corpus domains can be quickly integrated into the toolkit. For further details, please check the GitHub repository at https://github.com/jknafou/TransCorpus .
blocks.zh: TransCorpus工具包包括一个CLI(CLI),它具有四个主要指令:(1) transcorpus下载-corpus[域]允许用户从指定域获取一个程序符,(2) transcorpus预处理[域][目标语言][num-splits]允许用户在翻译前可选择预处理程序符,(3) transcorpus翻译[域][目标语言][num-splits]既处理预处理(如果以前没有完成),又翻译程序符符. 用户可以同时在众多的GPU和进程中进行预处理和翻译. 检查站恢复功能使用户能够从上次停止的地方恢复预处理或翻译,这对面临GPU使用时限的学者特别有利. 最后,(4) transcorpus预览[域][语言1][语言2]提供了两种语言的附带文件预览. 目前,只有生命科学仪器可以下载,但需更新域名。 在 GitHub 上的 json 文件带有新实体 URL, 额外实体域可以快速整合到工具包中. 详见https://github.com/jknafou/TransCorpus上的GitHub寄存器。

blocks.en: 4 TransCorpus-bio-fr: A French Life Sciences Corpus
blocks.zh: 4 TransCorpus-bio-fr: 法国生命科学公司

blocks.en: As already highlighted, the limited availability of DS PLM for certain language/domain pairs presents a notable challenge to the progression of NLP tools. Evaluating our framework in a real-world context is complex for several reasons: (1) it is uncommon to find sufficient DS for low-resource language/domain pairs that also have datasets for model evaluation, and (2) even when such benchmarks exist, an appropriate PLM for comparison might not be available. Fortunately, in the domain of French life sciences, two important papers have recently been published. The first is DrBenchmark Labrak et al. (2024b) a life sciences benchmark that includes multiple datasets supporting the evaluation of in-domain models. The second is DrBERT Labrak et al. (2023) , a French life sciences PLM . Comparing our model against DrBERT on life sciences tasks allows us to assess the practical effectiveness of our framework. Indeed, as DrBERT is pre-trained from scratch, it does not rely on an advanced general domain PLM such as CamemBERT Martin et al. (2020) , which is also the case for most languages.
blocks.zh: 正如已经强调的那样,某些语言/域配对可用的DS PLM有限,对NLP工具的进步构成显著的挑战。 在现实世界中评价我们的框架是复杂的,原因有几个:(1) 为资源少的语言/领域对配方找到足够的DS是少见的,这些配方也有用于模型评价的数据集;(2) 即使有这种基准,也可能无法找到适当的PLM进行比较。 幸运的是,在法国生命科学领域,最近发表了两篇重要论文. 第一个是Benchmark Labrak 等人(2024年b),这是一个生命科学基准,包括多个数据集,支持对域内模型的评价. 第二个是DrBERT Labrak等人(2023年),法国生命科学PLM. 在生命科学任务方面将我们的模型与DrBERT相比较,使我们能够评估我们框架的实际效力。 事实上,由于DrBERT是从零开始预先训练的,它并不依赖于先进的一般域PLM,如CamemberT Martin等人(2020年),大多数语言也是如此.

blocks.en: 4.1 MEDLINE/PubMed Abstracts Collection
blocks.zh: 4.1 MEDLINE/PubMed摘要集

blocks.en: For the building of this life sciences corpus, the 2021 MBR ( MBR ), encompassing 31M citations, and updates up until April 2021 was downloaded. Then, each citation in the dataset that includes a PMID, a title, and an abstract is kept, subsequently, its raw text is modified by substituting any sequence of one or more whitespace characters with a single space. An example of a title and abstract after modification, as it would appear prior to translation can be found in Appendix A.1 .
blocks.zh: 2021MBR(MBR)包含31M引文, 然后,数据集中包含一个PMID,一个标题,和一个抽象的每一个引用都会被保存下来,随后,它的原始文本会被修改,用一个空格来替换一个或多个白空格字符的任何序列. 标题和修改后的抽象例子,如翻译前所示,见附录A.1。

blocks.en: A considerable amount of citations lacks one of the three essential attributes, i.e. title, abstract, or PMID. Consequently, after filtering the complete dataset, our corpus comprises about 22M abstracts. Despite a few missing unknown values, a comprehensive comparison of our corpus statistics against several models can be found in Appendix A.2 . Despite both BioBERT and PubMedBERT Gu et al. (2020) have a version that also includes PMC ( PMC ) full-text articles, only those that use PubMed are displayed for a better comparison. This juxtaposition is crucial for understanding the scale of data that similar models have been trained on, which directly impacts their performance and applicability in various NLP tasks.
blocks.zh: 大量引用缺乏三个基本属性之一,即标题、抽象或PMID。 因此,在过滤了完整的数据集之后,我们的资料库包括大约22M摘要。 尽管缺少一些未知数值,但附录A.2全面比较了我们与若干模型的生物体统计数据。 尽管BioBERT和PubMedBERT Gu等人(2020年)都有包含PMC(PMC)全文文章的版本,但只有使用PubMed的版本被展示出来以进行更好的比较. 这种并列关系对于理解类似模型所培训的数据规模至关重要,这直接影响其性能和在各种NLP任务中的适用性。

blocks.en: 4.2 Translated Corpus Statistics
blocks.zh: 4.2 翻译公司统计

blocks.en: The complete translation process was executed using 32 NVIDIA Tesla V100 GPU with 32Go of memory each, taking roughly 15 days, which translates to approximately 11,520 GPU hours 5 5 5 These figures are based on an earlier version of TransCorpus; with the latest release of the toolkit, translating the corpus into Spanish requires 7 days using 6 NVIDIA A100 with 80GB of memory each. . After translation, the resultant raw text file is 36.4GB, containing 221M sentences and 5.25B words. Table 1 compares TransCorpus with the only two French life sciences corpora leveraged for pre-training. The comparison reveals that DrBERT the SOTA ( SOTA ) life sciences LM in French, despite it utilizes the largest corpus until now, is about five times smaller than TransCorpus.
blocks.zh: 完整的翻译过程使用32 NVIDIA Tesla V100 GPU执行,每集32Go的内存,大约需要15天,这大约翻译为11,520 GPU小时 5 5 5 这些数字基于较早版本的TransCorpus;随着工具包的最新发布,将本集翻译成西班牙语需要7天使用6 NVIDIA A100,每集80GB的内存. 翻译后,产生的原始文本文件为36.4GB,包含221M句子和5.25B词. 表1比较了TransCorpus与仅有的两家法国生命科学公司在培训前的应用。 比较后发现,尽管法语的SOTA(SOTA)生命科学LM(尽管它使用了迄今为止最大的生物体)比TransCorpus大约小5倍。

blocks.en: Even if the corpus size is important, its quality must also be closely monitored. While MBR is already considered a benchmark of quality in English as it is used for pre-training models such as BioBERT and PubMedBERT, it is crucial to assess the quality of our translations to make sure that everything has been conducted properly. As depicted in Figure 1 c , a comparable density check of the entire translated corpus reveals a density profile similar to the original corpus. After manually reviewing a randomly chosen set of abstracts, no irregular translation events, such as repetitions, were detected. A few translated abstracts alongside their counterparts originally written in French can be found in Appendix 6 . The translated corpus is available on Hugging Face at https://huggingface.co/datasets/jknafou/TransCorpus-bio-fr .
blocks.zh: 即使体积重要,也必须密切监测其质量。 虽然MBR已经被认为是英语质量的基准,因为它被用于BioBERT和PubMedBERT等培训前模式,但评估我们的翻译质量以确保一切工作都进行得当至关重要。 如图1c所示,对整个翻译体的可比较密度检查显示,其密度特征与原始体相似。 在手动审查随机选择的一组摘要后,没有发现重复等不规则翻译事件. 附录6载有与原文为法文的同行一起翻译的几份摘要。 译文见Hugging Face,https://huggingface.co/datasets/jknafou/TransCorpus-bio-fr。 。 。 。

blocks.en: 5 TransBERT Pre-Training
blocks.zh: 5 转录 培训前

blocks.en: The reasons for pre-training a LM from scratch are twofold. Firstly, it enables us to project the usage of our framework on languages that might lack a general domain PLM . Secondly, it allows the use of our custom tokenizer, which typically provides enhanced performance for DS LM .
blocks.zh: 从零开始进行LM预训的原因有两个。 首先,它使我们能够预测框架在可能缺乏一般域PLM的语言上的使用情况。 第二,它允许使用我们的自定义标语器,它通常为DS LM提供增强性能.

blocks.en: 5.1 TransTokenizer Training
blocks.zh: 5.1 变压器 培训

blocks.en: Subword segmentation algorithms aim to split words optimally using probability. Considering the potential addition of more languages in future works, choosing a tokenizer capable of handling specific linguistic features could prove beneficial. In that context, SentencePiece treats whitespaces as regular characters rather than relying on them, which means that it is suited for all kinds of languages. The original SentencePiece implementation 6 6 6 https://github.com/google/sentencepiece Kudo and Richardson (2018) is used to train an Unigram tokenizer with a vocabulary size of 32k and a character coverage set to 0.9995 (default values).
blocks.zh: 子词分割算法旨在最佳地利用概率来分割词. 考虑到在未来的作品中可能增加更多的语言,选择能够处理特定语言特征的示意剂可能证明是有益的. 在此背景下,PriedPiece将白空间视为常规字符而不是依赖它们,这意味着它适合各种语言. 原判 Piece 执行 6 6 6 https://github.com/google/pentencepic 工藤和理查森(2018年)用于训练一个词汇大小为32k的Unigram符号化器,字符覆盖范围设定为0.9995(默认值).

blocks.en: 5.2 Pre-training Hyperparameters
blocks.zh: 5.2 训练前超参数

blocks.en: A BERT architecture i.e. a Transformer encoder with 12 hidden layers, each with 12 attention heads of dimension 768, is pre-trained on TransCorpus following RoBERTa Liu et al. (2019) with an extensive batch size of 8k, an Adam Optimizer Kingma and Ba (2017) , along with 24k warm-up steps and a learning rate of 6e-4. The model was updated for 500k steps on a MLM ( MLM ) objective function.
blocks.zh: 一个BERT架构,即12个隐藏层的变形器编码器,每层有12个视星等768的注意力头,在RoBERTa Liu等人(2019年)之后的TransCorpus上进行预训,大批量尺寸为8k,一个Adam Optimizer Kingma和Ba(2017年),以及24k的热身步骤和6e-4的学习率. 该模型在MLM(MLM)客观功能上更新了500k步.

blocks.en: 6 TransBERT-bio-fr: Application to Life Sciences in French
blocks.zh: 6 TransBERT-bio-fr:法语生命科学应用

blocks.en: This section details the pre-training of TransBERT-bio-fr and compares it with other French PLM .
blocks.zh: 本节详述了TransBERT-bio-fr的预训,并将其与其他法国PLM进行比较.

blocks.en: 6.1 TransTokenizer-bio-fr Training
blocks.zh: 6.1 转接器-生电机培训

blocks.en: The tokenizer training on TransCorpus-bio-fr took approximately 12 hours on a single machine. As SentencePiece tokenizers require a considerable amount of RAM, a cut-off at 10M translated abstracts were randomly selected in order to train a DS tokenizer based on our synthetic translated corpus. An example showcasing the difference between the tokenization of TransTokenizer (ours) and CamemBERT’s tokenizer can be found in Appendix A.7 .
blocks.zh: 关于TransCorpus-bio-fr的标致器训练在一台单机上用了大约12小时. 由于PriedPiece的标识器需要相当数量的RAM,因此在10M的翻译摘要中随机选取了截号,以便根据我们的合成翻译本来训练DS的标识器. 一个显示TransTokenizer(我们)和CamemberT的标志化的区别的例子见附录A.7。

blocks.en: 6.2 CmTransBERT: Tokenizer Ablation
blocks.zh: 6.2 CmTransBERT: 托克尼泽

blocks.en: To evaluate the impact of the tokenizer, TransBERT-bio-fr is pre-trained using TransTokenizer-bio-fr while CmTransBERT is pre-trained using CamemBERT’s tokenizer. Both models are trained on the TransCorpus-bio-fr, with the same hyperparameters. Prior to fine-tuning our models, the PPPL ( PPPL ) Salazar et al. (2020) per token and word for each model was computed on a 50 authentic French abstracts. This step confirms the success of the pre-training and provides the go-ahead for the experimental phase. For further details, the results are presented in Appendix A.8 .
blocks.zh: 使用TransTokenizer-bio-fr进行预训, 而CmTransBERT则使用CamemberT的预训。 两个模型都接受了TransCorpus-bio-fr的培训,具有相同的超参数. 在调整我们的模型之前,根据50份法国正本摘要计算了每个符号和每个模型的PPPL(PPL) Salazar等人(2020年)。 这一步骤证实了前期训练的成功,并为实验阶段提供了前期训练. 详见附录A.8。

blocks.en: 6.3 Pre-training Statistics
blocks.zh: 6.3 培训前统计

blocks.en: Both TransBERT-bio-fr and CmTransBERT were pre-trained for approximately three months using a machine with 3 NVIDIA A100 GPUs, each with 80GB of memory. To ensure a fair pre-training comparison, TransBERT adopted RoBERTa’s training methodology, processing 4B sequences over 500k steps with a batch size of 8k. In contrast, DrBERT which represents the best effort for a LM for the life sciences domain in French was pre-trained on 310M sequences over 78k steps with a batch size of 4k. Therefore, while TransCorpus-bio-fr’s corpus is about five times larger than DrBERT’s, TransBERT-bio-fr’s overall training data updates are thirteen times larger compared to DrBERT. CamemBERT bio undergoes fewer training updates than DrBERT however, it keeps pre-training CamemBERT, a PLM already pre-trained for 100k steps using batch size of 8k. TransBERT-bio-fr and its tokenizer are available on Hugging Face at https://huggingface.co/jknafou/TransBERT-bio-fr .
blocks.zh: TransBERT-bio-fr和CmTransBERT都使用一台装有3台NVIDIA A100 GPU的机器进行约三个月的预训,每台都装有80GB的内存. 为了确保训练前的公平比较,TransBERT采用了RoBERTa的训练方法,处理超过500k步的4B序列,批量大小为8k. 与此相反,DrBERT是法语生命科学领域LM的最好方法,它在78k级的批量尺寸为4k级的310M级序列上进行了预先培训。 因此,尽管TransCorpus-bio-fr的体格比DrBERT的大约大五倍,但TransBERT-bio-fr的整体培训数据更新比DrBERT的大约大十三倍. 与DrBERT相比,CamemBERT Bio接受的训练更新较少,但是它保留了预训练CamemBERT,这个PLM已经预先训练了100k步,使用批量尺寸为8k. TransBERT-bio-fr及其标注器可在Hugging Face上查阅:https://huggingface.co/jknafou/TransBERT-bio-fr 。 。 。

blocks.en: 7 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 7 实验设置

blocks.en: To compare TransBERT-bio-fr with other PLM , we leveraged DrBenchmark which is composed of multiple datasets and tasks. This section describes the experimental setup under which each model was evaluated.
blocks.zh: 为了将TransBERT-bio-fr与其他PLM进行比较,我们利用了由多个数据集和任务组成的Benchmark博士。 本节介绍每个模型评价的实验设置.

blocks.en: 7.1 Baseline Models
blocks.zh: 7.1 基线模式

blocks.en: To evaluate our method against strong baselines, we selected the state-of-the-art French PLM, CamemBERT as well as DrBERT the only life sciences PLM pre-trained from scratch in French. As previously noted, CamemBERT bio was excluded from comparison because it is derived from CamemBERT rather than being trained from scratch, whereas our framework is specifically designed for scenarios where DS data are available in one language, but resources in the target language are lacking.
blocks.zh: 为了对照有力的基线来评估我们的方法,我们选择了法国最先进的PLM, CamemberT 以及DrBERT, 唯一的生命科学PLM 从零开始法语预训. 如前所述,CamemBERT生物因来源于CamemBERT而不是从零开始接受训练而被排除在比较之外,而我们的框架则专门针对以一种语言提供DS数据但缺乏目标语言资源的情况。

blocks.en: 7.2 DrBenchmark: An Adaptation
blocks.zh: 7.2 Benchmark博士:适应

blocks.en: Common LM benchmarks in life sciences are predominantly biomedical or clinical, such as BLURB ( BLURB ) Gu et al. (2021) and BLUE ( BLUE ) Peng et al. (2019) in English. In French, only one option was recently published: DrBenchmark. Available in our GitHub, an adaptation of the benchmark containing a few additions such as HPO ( HPO ) implementation instead of fixed hyperparameters setting, a few data cleaning steps to avoid duplicates, datasets merging to avoid unnecessary small datasets and the implementation of a k-fold cross-validation strategy with multiple iterations to allow for a more robust evaluation. Appendix A.9 shows the adapted benchmark datasets statistics, which includes 15 tasks, five of which are classification, six NER , two POS ( POS ), and two STS ( STS ).
blocks.zh: 生命科学中常见的LM基准以生物医学或临床为主,如BLURB(BLURB)Gu等人(2021年)和BLUE(BLUE)Peng等人(2019年)英文版. 法语中,最近只公布了一个选项:Benchmark博士. 可以在我们的GitHub中找到,该基准的修改包含一些附加内容,如HPO(HPO)实施而不是固定的超参数设置,一些数据清理步骤以避免重复,数据集合并以避免不必要的小数据集,以及实施K倍交叉验证策略,同时进行多个迭代,以便进行更强的评价. 附录A.9显示了经过调整的基准数据集统计,其中包括15项任务,其中5项是分类,6项NER,2项POS(POS),2项STS(STS).

blocks.en: 7.3 Statistical Testing
blocks.zh: 7.3 统计测试

blocks.en: Once a metric is computed for each label/class/entity/tag/regression, a statistical test is performed to assess if there is a significant difference between models (1) at the dataset level comparing labels performance across labels and folds and (2) at the task level comparing performances across labels, folds and datasets. For comparisons involving more than two models, the Friedman test is employed, followed by the Nemenyi test. When comparing two models, the Wilcoxon test is used. Appendix A.10 shows the statistical testing process following Demšar (2006) recommended practice for comparing metrics rankings to assess model difference for one or multiple datasets.
blocks.zh: 一旦为每个标签/类/实体/立方/递减计算出一个度量,将进行统计测试,以评估:(1) 在数据集一级,模型对标签和折叠的性能进行比较;(2) 在任务一级,模型对标签、折叠和数据集的性能进行比较。 对于涉及两个以上模型的比较,采用弗里德曼测试,其次是内梅尼测试. 在比较两个模型时,使用威尔科克斯测试. 附录A.10显示了按照Demšar(2006)的建议进行统计测试的过程,比较计量排名以评估一个或多个数据集的模型差异。

blocks.en: 8 Results & Discussion
blocks.zh: 8 结果和讨论

blocks.en: Table 2 presents models performances across all folds for each dataset with the weighted F 1 -score for each task except STS , which utilizes the R 2 metric. Among the 15 datasets evaluated, TransBERT ( TransBERT ) outperforms the other models in 10 cases, with statistical significance noted on four occasions. For instance, in DiaMed, TransBERT secures the highest F 1 -score for 55 labels over five folds, whereas CamemBERT and DrBERT attain the highest F 1 -score for 22 and 27 labels, respectively.

blocks.en: In classification tasks, even though CamemBERT achieves the top performance on two datasets, the differences in metrics and ranking between the models on these datasets are not significant. Conversely, on the DiaMed and MorFITT datasets where TransBERT outperforms, the distinction in metrics and ranking is notable and statistically significant.
blocks.zh: 在分类任务中,尽管CamemBERT在两个数据集上实现了顶级性能,但这些数据集上的模型在度量和排名上的差别并不显著. 相反,在TransBERT业绩超过的DiaMed和MORFITT数据集中,在计量和排名方面的区别是显著的,在统计学上具有重要意义。

blocks.en: In NER , TransBERT leads across all datasets in both metrics and rankings, achieving statistical significance in two instances. In POS tasks, the models demonstrate high and closely matched performances, with the lowest-scoring model achieving a weighted F 1 -score of 97.56. Despite this narrow margin, CamemBERT secures top results for one dataset, showing statistical significance and attaining the highest F 1 -score across 107 tags in all five folds. In STS , CamemBERT and TransBERT perform similarly, with minor differences, obtaining three and two top results, respectively. However, DrBERT performs poorly in this task, particularly with a margin exceeding 10 points in DEFT-2020/T1.

Beyond this diversity factor, if a provided sequence is too short for the model to deduce a context helping it identify the kind of document it is receiving, this may cause confusion, potentially resulting in ineffective learning. blocks.en: 8.2 Tokenizer Ablation Study

blocks.en: Although prior work by Labrak et al. (2024a) explored similar analyses, we identify methodological inconsistencies in their pre-training of 16 PLM . Specifically, the use of a fixed time-based stopping criterion resulted in unequal training durations across models, potentially biasing outcomes. Furthermore, the justification for employing reduced batch sizes remains unclear, although computational constraints may have been a contributing factor. To address these limitations, we performed systematic replication under controlled experimental conditions. To our knowledge, this study is the first rigorous examination of how tokenizer impacts DS PLM , offering insights for optimizing architecture decisions in resource-constrained scenarios.
blocks.zh: 虽然Labrak等人(2024年a)以前曾探讨过类似的分析,但我们发现,在对16个PLM进行预先培训时,方法不一致。 具体地说,使用固定的限时停止标准导致不同模式的培训期限不平等,可能带来偏差。 此外,采用减少批量规模的理由仍然不清楚,尽管计算方面的限制可能是促成因素。 为了消除这些局限性,我们在受控制的实验条件下进行了系统的复制。 据我们所知,本研究是对标致器如何影响DS PLM的首次严格审查,为在受资源限制的情景中优化结构决定提供了深刻见解。

blocks.en: 9 Conclusion & Contributions
blocks.zh: 9 结论和贡献

blocks.en: This work establishes a rigorous framework for assessing LM on DS for non-English dataset. It builds upon prior research and extends it to a more comprehensive benchmark that includes a more robust way of evaluating the models by applying HPO , multiple training repetition, 5-folds cross-validation, and statistical testing on 15 datasets along with their aggregation by task. It illustrates that employing translated synthetic data for training DS LM is a viable approach to address the lack of native language data. Our proposed model, TransBERT-bio-fr, outperforms existing SOTA models in various life sciences tasks, including classification, NER , POS , and STS .
blocks.zh: 这项工作为非英语数据集在DS上评估LM建立了严格的框架. 它以先前的研究为基础,并扩展至一个更全面的基准,包括采用更强有力的方法,通过采用HPO、多次培训重复、5倍交叉验证、对15个数据集进行统计测试以及按任务进行汇总来评价模型。 它表明,使用翻译合成数据进行DS LM培训是解决当地语言数据缺乏问题的可行办法。 我们提出的模型TransBERT-bio-fr在包括分类、NER、POS和STS在内的各种生命科学任务中超越了现有的SOTA模型。

blocks.en: In addition to offering a viable methodology to address data scarcity, we release to the public TransCorpus , an adaptative toolkit designed to facilitate the translation of large-scale corpora into multiple languages. The resources generated from this work, including TransCorpus-bio-fr , TransBERT-bio-fr and the code for the pre-training and fine-tuning of the models are also made available on GitHub .
blocks.zh: 除了提供解决数据稀缺问题的可行方法外,我们还向公众发布了一个适应性工具包TransCorpus,该工具包旨在促进将大型公司翻译成多种语言。 这项工作产生的资源,包括TransCorpus-bio-fr,TransBERT-bio-fr,以及模型的预训和微调代码,也在GitHub上提供。

blocks.en: 10 Future Work
blocks.zh: 10 未来工作

blocks.en: One encouraging direction for future research is to expand our approach to encompass a wider array of languages, especially those that are underrepresented in the life sciences field. Applying our methodology across various linguistic settings will help us better understand its generalizability and any possible constraints. Additionally, creating multilingual models capable of managing several languages within the life sciences sector poses a fascinating challenge. These models might exploit cross-lingual knowledge transfer, allowing for a more efficient use of scarce data resources and promoting a more inclusive global scientific community. Exploring other domains via our toolkit could also yield valuable insights into the adaptability of our approach.
blocks.zh: 今后研究的一个令人鼓舞的方向是扩大我们的做法,以包括更广泛的语言,特别是在生命科学领域代表性不足的语言。 将我们的方法应用于各种语言环境,将有助于我们更好地了解其普遍性和任何可能的限制。 此外,在生命科学部门建立能够管理几种语言的多语种模式是一个令人感兴趣的挑战。 这些模型可能利用跨语言的知识转让,从而能够更有效地利用稀缺的数据资源,并促进更具包容性的全球科学界。 通过我们的工具包探索其它领域,也可以对我们方法的适应性产生宝贵的见解。

blocks.en: Another path for future research is an extensive comparison between our method and the latest generative LLM on identical datasets. Such a comparison would yield valuable understanding of the trade-offs between specialized, domain-focused models and more general, resource-heavy models LLM . Assessing performance, efficiency, and cost-effectiveness across different life sciences tasks would help researchers and practitioners in making informed decisions. Furthermore, this analysis could highlight the possibility of integrating the strengths of both approaches.
blocks.zh: 未来研究的另一种途径是将我们的方法与相同数据集的最新基因LLM进行广泛的比较. 这种比较将使人们对专门化、以领域为重点的模型与更普遍、资源密集的LLM模型之间的权衡有宝贵的了解。 评估不同生命科学任务的业绩、效率和成本效益将有助于研究人员和从业人员作出知情决定。 此外,这种分析可以突出结合两种办法的优点的可能性。

blocks.en: A promising direction for upcoming research involves exploring the use of generative LLM to create synthetic data for training DS models, as an alternative to our translation-based method. This approach could yield more varied and nuanced datasets, encapsulating intricate DS knowledge and linguistic patterns. Assessing the quality, reliability, and possible biases of LM -generated synthetic data in comparison to translated data could offer valuable insights into data augmentation strategies for low-resource domains and languages.
blocks.zh: 未来研究的一个有希望的方向是探索使用基因LLM来制作用于培训DS模型的合成数据,作为我们基于翻译的方法的替代品。 这种方法可以产生更加多样和细微的数据集,概括复杂的DS知识和语言模式. 与翻译数据相比,评估LM生成的合成数据的质量、可靠性和可能的偏差,可以为低资源领域和语言的数据扩充战略提供宝贵的见解。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: 10.1 Baseline Model
blocks.zh: 10.1 基线模式

blocks.en: While TransBERT-bio-fr got better results than CamemBERT, it would be interesting to see if DrBERT, the DS baseline PLM would have had better results if it had undergone a proper pre-training process (e.g., 500k steps, 8k batch size, etc.). Also, in order to extend our approach to languages where high quality PLM are available, it would have been interesting to compare a pre-training continuation of CamemBERT on TransCorpus-bio-fr with CamemBERT bio.
blocks.zh: 虽然TransBERT-bio-fr取得了比CamemBERT更好的结果,但如果DrBERT,DS基线PLM经过适当的预训过程(如500k步,8k批量大小等),那么如果DrBERT,PLM会有更好的结果. 此外,为了将我们的方法推广到有高质量PLM的语文,将CamemBERT在TransCorpus-bio-fr上的预培训续作与CamemBERT的生物作一比较会很有趣。

blocks.en: 10.2 In-Domain/Language Generalization
blocks.zh: 10.2 域内/语言

blocks.en: Even though our benchmark includes a broad range of datasets and tasks, it is impossible to cover every potential application or future development in the field. The performance of our model, while impressive within the scope of our study, may not necessarily be consistent across all possible tasks or datasets in the life sciences domain. Additionally, the idea of a universally ’best’ model is inherently flawed in the realm of NLP . Different models might excel in particular contexts or specific types of tasks, and their performance can be affected by factors such as domain specificity, data distribution, and the nuances of individual use cases. What works optimally in one scenario may not be the best choice in another, emphasizing the need for context-specific model evaluation and selection. It is also important to recognize that the fast-paced advancements in NLP research could lead to new architectures, pre-training techniques, or fine-tuning strategies that may surpass our current model in certain aspects. The dynamic nature of the field requires ongoing evaluation and comparison against new innovations.
blocks.zh: 尽管我们的基准包括广泛的数据集和任务,但不可能涵盖该领域的每一个潜在应用或未来发展。 我们模型的表现虽然在我们的研究范围内令人印象深刻,但不一定与生命科学领域所有可能的任务或数据集保持一致。 此外,关于普遍最佳模式的想法在NLP领域内在存在缺陷。 不同模型在特定背景或特定类型的任务中可能优异,其性能可能受到诸如域特异性、数据分布和个别使用案例的细微差别等因素的影响。 在一个设想中最可行的可能不是另一个设想中的最佳选择,强调需要针对具体情况的模型评价和选择。 还有必要认识到,NLP研究的快速进步可能导致新的架构、培训前技术或微调战略,在某些方面可能超越我们目前的模式。 外地的动态性质要求不断进行评估,并与新的创新进行比较。

blocks.en: 10.3 Other Domains Generalization
blocks.zh: 10.3 其他领域

blocks.en: Although our model, which was trained on translated synthetic data within the life sciences corpus, shows encouraging generalization towards other domains, it is important to recognize the constraints when extrapolating these results to other areas. The success of our method in addressing the lack of native language data in life sciences should not be automatically expected to apply to other specialized sectors such as finance, law, or engineering. Each field presents its own unique linguistic hurdles, specialized terminologies, and DS conceptual frameworks that general-purpose MT systems might not handle effectively. The quality and relevance of translated synthetic data can differ greatly between domains, possibly affecting the model’s performance. Moreover, the subtleties of DS language use, such as idiomatic phrases, technical lingo, and context-dependent meanings, may not be accurately preserved in translated data, which could lead to misunderstandings or errors in other fields. Additionally, the success of our approach may depend on the degree to which translatable concepts are within a given domain, which can vary greatly. For example, concepts that are highly specific to a culture or legally bound in sectors like law or social sciences might pose particular difficulties for this approach. Hence, even if our results suggest a promising avenue for mitigating language resource shortages in specialized fields, further research is essential to confirm the broad applicability of this method across various domains, each with its own distinct linguistic and conceptual challenges.
blocks.zh: 虽然我们在生命科学仪器中接受过翻译合成数据培训的模型显示,对其他领域的泛化令人鼓舞,但在将这些结果推向其他领域时必须认识到这些制约因素。 我们的方法在解决生命科学中缺乏当地语言数据的问题方面所取得的成功不应自动适用于其他专门部门,如财政、法律或工程。 每一个领域都提出其自身独特的语言障碍、专门术语和DS概念框架,而通用MT系统可能无法有效处理这些障碍。 翻译合成数据的质量和相关性在不同领域之间可能有很大差异,可能影响模型的性能。 此外,DS语言使用的微妙之处,如平话,技术语言,以及上下文依赖的含义,在翻译数据中可能无法准确保存,这可能导致其他领域的误解或错误. 此外,我们的办法能否成功,可能取决于某一领域内可转换概念的程度,而这些概念可能有很大差异。 例如,对一种文化极为具体或法律或社会科学等部门具有法律约束力的概念可能对这种办法造成特别困难。 因此,即使我们的结果表明缓解专门领域语言资源短缺的途径是很有希望的,但必须开展进一步研究,确认这种方法在各个领域的广泛适用性,每个领域都有独特的语言和概念挑战。

blocks.en: 10.4 Other Languages Generalization
blocks.zh: 10.4 其他语文

blocks.en: While our study highlights the effectiveness of employing synthetic translated data for training LM in the field of life sciences in French, caution is warranted when applying these findings to other languages, especially those with limited resources. We believe that the success of our method is highly dependent on the quality and availability of MT systems for the target language, which can differ greatly among various language pairs. Even if M2M-100 has a great potential to secure relatively great results in low-resource languages compared to other models, some language pairs often lack strong machine translation models, which can undermine the quality of the translated synthetic data. For instance, Guerreiro et al. (2023) show that MT models can encounter difficulties with hallucinations, especially in low-resource language directions and when translating out of English languages, which may result in misleading outcomes. Additionally, the linguistic gap between the source language and the target language can greatly affect the effectiveness of the approach. Languages with different syntactic frameworks, morphological structures, or writing systems might pose additional difficulties in maintaining semantic subtleties and DS language during translation. Furthermore, the cultural and scientific context embedded in the original material might not always have direct counterparts in the target language or culture, which could result in meaning loss or the introduction of biases. Although our findings indicate a potential solution for addressing the deficit of scientific corpora in some languages, the method’s suitability across different linguistic contexts requires thorough evaluation and additional investigation.
blocks.zh: 虽然我们的研究强调了使用合成翻译数据在生命科学领域用法语进行LM培训的有效性,但在将这些研究结果应用于其他语言,特别是资源有限的语言时,必须谨慎从事。 我们认为,我们的方法能否成功,在很大程度上取决于目标语言的MT系统的质量和可用性,不同语言对等之间可能有很大差异. 即使与其它模型相比,M2M-100在低资源语言中具有获得相对较大结果的巨大潜力,但一些语言配对经常缺乏强大的机器翻译模型,这可能会破坏翻译合成数据的质量. 例如,Guerreiro等人(2023年)表明,MT模型可能会遇到幻觉方面的困难,特别是在资源较少的语言方向和英语翻译时,这可能导致误导结果。 此外,源语言与目标语言之间的语言差距会大大影响方法的有效性. 具有不同合成框架,形态结构,或书写系统的语言,在翻译过程中可能给维持语义微妙性和DS语言带来额外的困难. 此外,原始材料中蕴含的文化和科学背景可能并不总是具有目标语言或文化的直接对应性,这可能意味着丧失或引入偏见。 虽然我们的调查结果表明,解决某些语言的科学公司不足问题有潜在的解决办法,但这种方法在不同语言背景下的适宜性需要彻底评估和更多的调查。

blocks.en: Figure 8: Statistical Testing - In order to compare more than two models, the Friedman test is used to determine if there is a significant difference between models, if so, the Nemenyi post-hoc test is used to determine which models are significantly different.
